source.trusted_section: WP G4-12 — Ink Playground 0.1 / Physical Integration

trusted_statements.goal: Close the current G4 functional integration profile with a runnable Ink Playground 0.1 on Web, Windows, and Android.
required: Web functional smoke with independent strokes and aligned coordinates
Windows functional smoke with real HWND and native input
Windows Arc functional qualification with automatic preview release
Android functional smoke with installable Activity and MotionEvent history
Durable platform evidence bound to exact revisions
forbidden: platform brush selection or eraser semantics
